o1.biggest_strength: Six truly different angles (transparency, taste, sugar, protein/texture, 4 pm, price) with a launch plan that changes only the primary text inside each pair, so every result is clean.

o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Tie the keep and cut lines to gross profit per order rather than just the best live CPA, and add one wittier headline for the taste angle in Aditya's 'brownie, not a supplement' words.

o2.biggest_mistake: Several texts repeat the '12 g protein, no added sugar' formula. Two angles are transparency and two are taste, with no standalone 4 pm angle. Each launch combo also changes the headline and description at the same time, which muddies what it tests.

reason: Output 1 gives me six angles that actually differ, a clean head-to-head of the paused winner against taste, and a budget I can launch tomorrow.
